title: Dilation change of variables for H^n set integrals over blow-up images η_{x,r}(M)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^N (= Euclidean N) and r > 0. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set and F : ℝ^N → ℝ an arbitrary function. Let η := Chapter03.blowUpMap x r, so η(y) = r⁻¹ • (y − x), and let H^n := μHE[n]. Then ∫_{η(M)} F dH^n = r⁻¹^n · ∫_M F(η(z)) dH^n(z), as Bochner set integrals; no measurability or integrability is assumed of M or F.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (x : Euclidean N) (r : ℝ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (F : Euclidean N → ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ y in Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, F y ∂μHE[n] = r⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z in M, F (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]
